schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. No set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0, so ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the values of the parameter table, which are also the values in force. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range, so there are no ProvenAcceptableRange records. Each parameter is anchored on its row of the parameter table and on its sentence of the factors section that states the range studied against the NOR.

UF/DF has no designed experiment, no design space and no intermediate acceptance criterion. The studies of the plan are the scale-down qualification and the univariate study. Neither StudyDesign carries n_runs or n_center_points: the qualification compares scale-down runs with manufacturing-scale batches, and the set-point replicates of the univariate study are not centre points of the ranges studied; the run counts are statements. StudyDesign.responses name the outputs as the document names them (the attributes of the attribute table, the outputs of the scale-down qualification table), not response keys. Studies of the step made after Version 1.0 are not studies of this plan; PCR-010 records them as discrepancies from it: S-UFDF-UNI2 (PD-010-01).

acceptance_criteria: the plan prints no criteria-change table. The in-force records are the drug substance criteria for aggregate and the acidic charge variants, which apply directly at the last step, as the product quality section states them, and the buffer-exchange criterion kept from Version 1.0 (attribute 'buffer_exchange', not a CQA: the number of diavolumes at or below which the conductivity and pH of the retentate must reach the plateau of the formulation buffer). The superseded record is the upper limit alone against which the Version 1.0 report read the acidic charge variants (INV-001 finding 4); Version 1.0 of the plan stated the two-sided criterion.

The plan prints no methods table. Each AnalyticalMethod is anchored on its sentence of the analytical methods section and its row of the procedures table, and SEC and icIEF also on the row of the attribute table that names them. A280 measures the protein concentration, on which the final concentration achieved (a parameter) and the mass balance rest, so that record has no associated attribute and no attribute_measured_by_method assertion. Conductivity and pH are in-process readings, not methods, and appear as an ExplicitNonClaim.

parameter_impacts_attribute assertions are the plan's stated expectations from prior knowledge, not results. The three acidic charge variant assertions rest on two sentences, the one that names how each parameter lengthens the operation and the one that says the increase grows with the time in solution.

The rows of the qualification-output table anchor the records they attest: the outputs compared at both scales the qualification StudyDesign, the two outputs not compared the ExplicitNonClaim on their unknown offsets, and the buffer-exchange row its acceptance criterion. The sampling rows and the planned runs (Appendix A) anchor the univariate StudyDesign; of the run-settings rows only those that occur once in the document are used, because the three set-point rows read alike. The commercial skid is an Equipment record at the receiving site, anchored on the objective that names it and on the roles-table row of the receiving site. The approvals table, the abbreviations and the remaining rows of the roles table are not represented. No rhetorical_spans: a plan has none. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: The last step of the drug substance train. Ultrafiltration across a tangential flow membrane concentrates the antibody, diafiltration at constant volume exchanges the process buffer for the formulation buffer, and a second concentration brings the drug substance to its target of 75 g/L before a buffer flush recovers the retentate. The step can add to aggregate and to the acidic charge variants.
input_materials: filtrate pool of the small virus retentive filtration step
output_materials: A-Mab drug substance in the formulation buffer at 75 g/L

source_references.quote: This plan defines the process characterization studies for the ultrafiltration and diafiltration (UF/DF) step of the A-Mab drug substance process.
UF/DF is Step 10, the last step of the drug substance train, and it delivers the drug substance at its target concentration of 75 g/L.
The UF/DF step concentrates the antibody and exchanges the process buffer for the formulation buffer.
The step receives the filtrate pool of the small virus retentive filtration step.
Development site | Cambridge, MA
Commercial drug substance site | Grafton, WI

statements.statement_text: The plan keeps the two-sided criterion for the acidic charge variants, and PCR-010 records the departure.

source_references.quote: This plan keeps the two-sided criterion, and PCR-010 records the departure.

statements.statement_text: The rule of Version 1.0 for the scale-down model is replaced by the offset rule of PCMP-001 §7.1.

source_references.quote: The rule of Version 1.0 for the scale-down model is replaced by the offset rule of PCMP-001 §7.1

statements.statement_text: Aggregate and the acidic charge variants are each judged on single runs and not on a mean, as PCMP-001 §6.2 requires for a quality attribute.

source_references.quote: Each is judged on single runs and not on a mean, as PCMP-001 §6.2 requires for a quality attribute

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 Version 2.0 sets nrCE-SDS as the method for fragments wherever a study measures them, following AMD-001 of 2026-03-20.

source_references.quote: PCMP-001 Version 2.0 sets non-reduced CE-SDS (nrCE-SDS) as the method for fragments wherever a study measures them, following the analytical method decision AMD-001 of 2026-03-20 (PCMP-001 §7.8).

statements.statement_text: The execution window of each study and the calibration status of its skid are given, which answers INV-001 finding 5.

source_references.quote: This answers INV-001 finding 5, that the Version 1.0 records gave no execution dates and the equipment tables therefore appeared to cite expired calibrations.

statements.statement_text: The title block of Version 1.0 carried 2026-07-24, the date on which the Version 1.0 reports were approved.

source_references.quote: The title block of Version 1.0 carried 2026-07-24, the date on which the Version 1.0 reports were approved.

statements.statement_text: Under PCMP-001 §6.2 an attribute is called affected by a parameter when a term that contains the parameter is significant; the rule is added to the classification.

source_references.quote: an attribute is called affected by a parameter when a term that contains the parameter is significant at that level
Two rules of PCMP-001 Version 2.0 are added to the classification

statements.statement_text: Under PCMP-001 §7.7 a significant effect that is too small to move the attribute appreciably within the PAR does not by itself make a parameter critical; the rule is added to the classification.

source_references.quote: a significant effect that is too small to move the attribute appreciably within the PAR does not by itself make a parameter critical
Two rules of PCMP-001 Version 2.0 are added to the classification

statements.statement_text: The TMP and the final DS concentration share one route to the product, the polarization layer.

source_references.quote: The TMP and the final DS concentration share one route, the polarization layer.

statements.statement_text: With the crossflow and the membrane loading matched per unit area, the antibody passes through the pump as often at bench scale as at commercial scale.

source_references.quote: With the crossflow and the membrane loading matched per unit area, the passes are the same at both scales.

statements.statement_text: The studies determine the effect of the number of diavolumes, the TMP and the final DS concentration on aggregate and on the acidic charge variants of the drug substance.

source_references.quote: To determine the effect of the number of diavolumes, the TMP and the final DS concentration on aggregate and on the acidic charge variants of the drug substance

statements.statement_text: The studies establish the number of diavolumes at which the retentate reaches the formulation buffer, so that the lower edge of the operating range rests on data for A-Mab.

source_references.quote: To establish the number of diavolumes at which the retentate reaches the formulation buffer, so that the lower edge of the operating range rests on data for A-Mab and not on platform practice alone.

statements.statement_text: The studies establish a PAR for each of the three parameters against the drug substance criteria for aggregate and the acidic charge variants.

source_references.quote: To establish a PAR for each of the three parameters against the drug substance criteria for aggregate and the acidic charge variants

statements.statement_text: The step is operated under SOP-2013, the scale-down model is qualified under SOP-1001, and the parameters are classified after the studies under SOP-4001.

source_references.quote: The step is operated under SOP-2013, the scale-down model is qualified under SOP-1001, and the parameters are classified after the studies under SOP-4001.

statements.statement_text: The antibody accumulates at the membrane wall in a polarization layer, where its concentration is higher than in the bulk retentate.

source_references.quote: The membrane retains the antibody, so the antibody accumulates at the membrane wall in a polarization layer, where its concentration is higher than in the bulk retentate.

statements.statement_text: Aggregate can form at the membrane wall, where the antibody is most concentrated, and in the pump, where cavitation, air–liquid interfaces and particles shed by the pump can start it.

source_references.quote: Aggregate can form at the wall, where the antibody is most concentrated, and in the pump, where cavitation, air–liquid interfaces and particles shed by the pump can start it.

statements.statement_text: The expectations for the step come from general knowledge of the tangential flow filtration of antibodies, not from the A-Mab case study.

source_references.quote: The expectations in the rest of this section come from general knowledge of the tangential flow filtration of antibodies.
The A-Mab case study leaves the UF/DF step out

statements.statement_text: Deamidation of asparagine residues continues for as long as the step keeps the antibody in solution.

source_references.quote: The step keeps the antibody in solution for the length of the operation, and deamidation of asparagine residues continues during that time.

statements.statement_text: The final DS concentration is studied for A-Mab and is not carried over from the platform.

source_references.quote: For this reason the final DS concentration is studied for A-Mab and is not carried over from the platform.

statements.statement_text: The studies measure two attributes of the drug substance across the step.

source_references.quote: The studies measure two attributes of the drug substance across the step.

statements.statement_text: Both attributes arrive with the load, and the studies measure what the step adds to each, against the load from the virus filtration step.

source_references.quote: The studies measure what this step adds to each, against the load from the virus filtration step.
Both attributes arrive with the load.

statements.statement_text: All three parameters of the step were assigned to univariate study in RA-001.

source_references.quote: All three parameters of this step were assigned to univariate study.

statements.statement_text: The effect of the TMP depends on the final DS concentration, and an interaction between them is possible.

source_references.quote: The effect of the TMP depends on the final DS concentration, and an interaction between them is possible.

statements.statement_text: The scale-down model holds the crossflow and the membrane loading at their commercial values, both scaled by membrane area.

source_references.quote: The model holds the crossflow and the membrane loading at their commercial values, both scaled by membrane area (PCMP-001 §5).

statements.statement_text: The share of the batch held up in the system cannot be matched: the bench system holds a larger share of its batch in its recirculation loop and has a larger ratio of surface to volume.

source_references.quote: The bench system, however, holds a larger share of its batch in its recirculation loop and has a larger ratio of surface to volume.
One quantity cannot be matched, the share of the batch held up in the system.

statements.statement_text: In study S-UFDF-SDM, three runs at the set-point condition are compared with the pilot and commercial record on the step yield, the permeate flux, the final concentration achieved and the change in aggregate content across the step.

source_references.quote: The qualification runs are made under SOP-1001, in study S-UFDF-SDM, where three runs at the set-point condition are compared with the pilot and commercial record of the step on the step yield, the permeate flux at the set-point TMP, the final concentration achieved and the change in aggregate content across the step.

statements.statement_text: The offset of each output is the mean of the scale-down runs at set-point minus the mean of the manufacturing-scale batches, reported with its two-sided 90 % confidence interval.

source_references.quote: Under the master plan PCMP-001 §7.1 the offset of each output is the mean of the scale-down runs at set-point minus the mean of the manufacturing-scale batches, reported with its two-sided 90 % confidence interval.

statements.statement_text: Every judgement of a scale-down aggregate result against its criterion first subtracts the aggregate offset, so the conclusion is stated at manufacturing scale.

source_references.quote: Every judgement of a scale-down aggregate result against that criterion first subtracts the aggregate offset, as PCMP-001 §7.1 requires for an output with a criterion, so the conclusion is stated at manufacturing scale.

statements.statement_text: At the set-point condition the step runs 8 DV at a TMP of 12 psi to a final concentration of 75 g/L.

source_references.quote: At the set-point condition the step runs 8 DV at a TMP of 12 psi to a final concentration of 75 g/L.

statements.statement_text: All runs of the study are loaded from a single pool of the virus filtration step, so that the variability of the load does not confound the comparison between the levels of a parameter.

source_references.quote: All runs of the study are loaded from a single pool of the virus filtration step, so that the variability of the load does not confound the comparison between the levels of a parameter.

statements.statement_text: A change across the step in the low aggregate content of A-Mab may be of the same size as the repeatability of the SEC method.

source_references.quote: The aggregate content of A-Mab drug substance is low, and a change across this step may be of the same size as the repeatability of the SEC method.

statements.statement_text: For each parameter and each response, the measured values are regressed on the level of the parameter and the slope is tested against zero at α = 0.05.

source_references.quote: For each parameter and each response, the measured values will be regressed on the level of the parameter over the range studied, and the slope will be tested against zero at α = 0.05.

statements.statement_text: The set-point replicates give the pure error estimate of the combined process and assay variability, against which a change across a range is read.

source_references.quote: Those replicates give the pure error estimate of the combined process and assay variability, against which a change across a range is read.

statements.statement_text: Under PCMP-001 §6.2 an attribute is called affected by a parameter when the slope is significant at that level.

source_references.quote: under it an attribute is called affected by a parameter when the slope is significant at that level

statements.statement_text: The criterion rather than the p-value decides whether a range is acceptable.

source_references.quote: the criterion rather than the p-value decides whether the range is acceptable

statements.statement_text: The buffer-exchange analysis reports the number of diavolumes at which the conductivity of the retentate has reached the plateau set by the formulation buffer.

source_references.quote: The analysis reports the number of diavolumes at which the conductivity of the retentate has reached the plateau set by the formulation buffer and no further change is measured over the following diavolume.

statements.statement_text: The diavolume range extends above the NOR because more diavolumes mean more time on the skid and more passes through the pump.

source_references.quote: The range extends above the NOR because more diavolumes mean more time on the skid and more passes through the pump.

statements.statement_text: The lower edge of the diavolume range is the lower edge of the NOR, the lowest count the commercial step will run.

source_references.quote: Its lower edge is the lower edge of the NOR, which is the lowest count the commercial step will run, and the buffer exchange curve characterizes the step at that value.

statements.statement_text: The TMP range extends above the NOR because pressure above the flux limit compacts the polarization layer without raising throughput.

source_references.quote: The range extends above the NOR because pressure above the flux limit compacts the polarization layer without raising throughput, so more of the antibody sits at the highest concentration at the wall.

statements.statement_text: An excursion of the final DS concentration above the target raises the risk of aggregation.

source_references.quote: An excursion above the target raises the viscosity and the bulk concentration of the retentate, lowers the flux and lengthens the operation, and so raises the risk of aggregation.

statements.statement_text: An excursion of the final DS concentration below the target leaves the drug substance below the concentration that the drug product program expects.

source_references.quote: An excursion below the target leaves the drug substance below the concentration that the drug product program expects.

statements.statement_text: Each parameter is run at three levels, the two edges of its range studied and its set-point, with the other parameters at their set-points.

source_references.quote: Each parameter is run at three levels, the two edges of its range studied and its set-point, with the other two parameters held at their set-points.

statements.statement_text: The univariate study consists of six edge runs and three replicates of the set-point condition, nine runs in all.

source_references.quote: The set-point condition is common to the three series, so the study consists of six edge runs and three replicates of the set-point condition, nine runs in all.

statements.statement_text: The order of execution will be randomized across the whole study.

source_references.quote: The order of execution will be randomized across the whole study.

statements.statement_text: Under PCMP-001 a model is qualified for an output when the conclusion over the NOR is the same with the offset at either end of its confidence interval, drawn from the response-surface model of the step.

source_references.quote: Under PCMP-001 a model is qualified for an output when the conclusion over the NOR is the same with the offset at either end of its confidence interval, and that conclusion is drawn from the response-surface model of the step.

statements.statement_text: The final retentate must contain no more than 5 % HMW aggregate.

source_references.quote: Aggregate must not exceed 5 % HMW

statements.statement_text: The acidic charge variants of the final retentate must lie between 18 and 40 %.

source_references.quote: the acidic charge variants must lie between 18 and 40 %

statements.statement_text: The drug substance criteria come from the CQA register, and no result of the studies of the plan enters them.

source_references.quote: They come from the drug substance CQA register (PCMP-001 §3), and no result of the studies of this plan enters them.

statements.statement_text: The a priori derivation in PCMP-001 assumes that no step after cation exchange changes aggregate, and that no step after low-pH viral inactivation changes the acidic charge variants.

source_references.quote: The a priori derivation in PCMP-001 assumes that no step after cation exchange changes aggregate, and that no step after low-pH viral inactivation changes the acidic charge variants (PCMP-001 Table 7.1).

statements.statement_text: The UF/DF step can add to aggregate and to the acidic charge variants, and its studies measure what it adds.

source_references.quote: This step can add to both, and the studies of this plan measure what it adds.

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 Version 2.0 sets the aggregate increase across UF/DF at 0.104 percentage points, the prediction bound of a single batch within its NOR, and every aggregate criterion of the earlier steps carries that increase.

source_references.quote: PCMP-001 Version 2.0 sets the aggregate increase across this step at 0.104 percentage points, the prediction bound of a single batch within its NOR, and every aggregate criterion of the earlier steps carries that increase (PCMP-001 §7.3).

statements.statement_text: The buffer exchange is accepted when the conductivity and the pH of the retentate have reached the plateau of the formulation buffer, at or below the lower edge of the diavolume NOR; the criterion is that of Version 1.0.

source_references.quote: The buffer exchange is accepted when the conductivity and the pH of the retentate have reached the plateau of the formulation buffer
at or below the lower edge of the diavolume NOR of 7 DV
The buffer-exchange criterion is that of Version 1.0.

statements.statement_text: A level of a parameter is acceptable when every attribute measured on the final retentate of that run meets its criterion.

source_references.quote: A level of a parameter is acceptable when every attribute measured on the final retentate of that run meets its criterion.

statements.statement_text: A parameter passes over its range studied when every level in the range is acceptable and the change measured across the range is small against the criterion.

source_references.quote: A parameter passes over its range studied when every level in the range is acceptable and the change measured across the range is small against the criterion.

statements.statement_text: Where a level fails, the range is truncated at the last acceptable level, and the failing level is reported as an edge of failure.

source_references.quote: Where a level fails, the range is truncated at the last acceptable level, and the failing level is reported as an edge of failure.

statements.statement_text: Where a failure occurs at a level inside the NOR, execution stops, and the operating range is reviewed with the receiving site and with QA before the study continues.

source_references.quote: Where a failure occurs at a level inside the NOR, execution stops, and the operating range is reviewed with the receiving site and with QA before the study continues.

statements.statement_text: Where a run fails for a reason attributable to the equipment or to the method, and not to the parameter under study, the run may be repeated once.

source_references.quote: Where a run fails for a reason attributable to the equipment or to the method, and not to the parameter under study, the run may be repeated once.

statements.statement_text: A parameter whose variation over the characterized range affects no quality attribute, but whose control is needed for the step to perform consistently, is a key process parameter.

source_references.quote: A parameter whose variation over the characterized range affects no quality attribute, but whose control is needed for the step to perform consistently, is classified as a key process parameter.

statements.statement_text: A parameter whose variation affects a quality attribute is critical, or well controlled critical where the risk of falling outside the design space is low.

source_references.quote: A parameter whose variation affects a quality attribute is classified as critical, or as well controlled critical where the risk of falling outside the design space is low.

statements.statement_text: A parameter studied one factor at a time is classified by the same rules as one studied in a design.

source_references.quote: a parameter studied one factor at a time is classified by the same rules as one studied in a design (PCMP-001 §4)

statements.statement_text: The PAR of a parameter is the contiguous span of levels over which every attribute measured on the final retentate met its criterion, with the other parameters at their set-points.

source_references.quote: The PAR of a parameter is the contiguous span of levels over which every attribute measured on the final retentate met its criterion, with the other parameters at their set-points.

statements.statement_text: A PAR cannot be wider than the range studied.

source_references.quote: A PAR cannot be wider than the range studied.

statements.statement_text: Where a PAR is wider than the NOR, the margin between them is what a deviation is dispositioned against.

source_references.quote: Where a PAR is wider than the NOR, the margin between them is what a deviation is dispositioned against.

statements.statement_text: Where a PAR is truncated at an edge of failure, the NOR should be reviewed against the truncated range before the step is transferred.

source_references.quote: Where a PAR is truncated at an edge of failure, the NOR should be reviewed against the truncated range before the step is transferred.

statements.statement_text: As INV-001 preventive action PA3 requires, the study record gives the execution dates of each study and the calibration status of the equipment it used.

source_references.quote: As INV-001 preventive action PA3 requires, the study record also gives the execution dates of each study and the calibration status of the equipment it used.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 is the amendment that INV-001 required of each step plan as a corrective action, issued after the runs and approved on its effective date, 2026-09-30.

source_references.quote: This Version 2.0 is the amendment that INV-001 required of each step plan as a corrective action, issued after the runs and approved on its effective date, 2026-09-30.

statements.statement_text: The deliverable of the plan is the report PCR-010, the process characterization report for the step.

source_references.quote: The deliverable of this plan is the report PCR-010, the process characterization report for the step.

statements.statement_text: The studies of the plan ran on the skid EQ-TFF-142, whose next calibration was due on 2026-04-22; the qualification study ended before the univariate study began, and both windows closed before that date.

source_references.quote: The qualification study ended before the univariate study began, and both windows closed before the calibration due date.
on the skid EQ-TFF-142, whose next calibration was due on 2026-04-22

statements.statement_text: If aggregate fails its criterion at bench scale, the condition will be repeated at pilot scale before an operating range is narrowed on the strength of the bench result.

source_references.quote: If aggregate fails its criterion at bench scale, the condition will be repeated at pilot scale before an operating range is narrowed on the strength of the bench result.

statements.statement_text: The slope test of each series rests on few runs, and an effect that is small against the variability between runs may not reach significance.

source_references.quote: The slope test of each series therefore rests on few runs, and an effect that is small against the variability between runs may not reach significance.

statements.statement_text: A change to the formulation would change the target of the buffer exchange and would invalidate the diavolume study.

source_references.quote: A change to the formulation would change the target of the buffer exchange and would invalidate the diavolume study.

statements.statement_text: A change to the design, to the ranges or to the acceptance criteria after approval requires a revision of the plan before the affected runs are executed.

source_references.quote: A change to the design, to the ranges or to the acceptance criteria after approval requires a revision of this plan, approved by the same functions, before the affected runs are executed.

source_references.quote: Both operations run across a tangential flow membrane whose pores pass buffer salts and retain the antibody.
